metadata.note: The provider boundary here is a child process, not an HTTP service, so the consumer-driven expectations are over argv, environment, exit code, and the stdout document rather than over a request/response pair. Verified by test/contract.test.ts.

invariants.noShell: argv is passed as an array to an injected ProcessRunner; the runner must not spawn a shell
invariants.noAmbientEnvironment: only the keys in `environment` are passed to the child
invariants.noLatestSpecifier: the package specifier must name an exact reviewed version

interactions.description: create a temporary database and ask for the machine-readable document

stdout.deletionDate: <ISO 8601 instant computed by the CLI's local clock>
stdout.name: <ISO 8601 creation instant used as the default name>

interactions.description: create in a documented region, as one fused argv element
ask for a shorter lifetime than the 24-hour default

request.note: The pinned CLI accepts 30m or 1h-24h. A shorter TTL is the only blast-radius control available on an anonymous database, so it is worth being able to ask for one.

interactions.description: rate limited by the create-db worker
upstream 5xx: the CLI reached the service, so a create may or may not have happened
the CLI dies without printing a document

response.note: The idempotency key stays in-flight: there is no read-by-id API, so a retry could orphan an unreachable project.

interactions.description: a CLI build without --json prints the documented pretty output
